The structure of Sm₂Mg₈Cu₄ (reduced formula SmMg₄Cu₂) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows each Cu and Sm center coordinated by 12 Mg neighbors, while each Mg center has 12 neighbors (4 Cu, 2 Mg, 6 Sm), all exhibiting a close-packed-like local arrangement. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Cu-, Mg-, and Sm-centered polyhedra.
